Package logic

Class EntryResult

java.lang.Object
logic.EntryResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EntryResult extends Object implements Serializable
result returned by the server after a gate check-in attempt.

sent as the payload of ENTRY_APPROVED on success, or ENTRY_DENIED carries the error string instead. displayed in the entry-result card of EntryControlController.

  • Constructor Details

    • EntryResult

      public EntryResult(boolean success, boolean prebooked, int orderId, String parkName, String visitorId, int numVisitors, String orderType, double totalPrice, String message)
      Parameters:
      success - true if entry was approved
      prebooked - true if a confirmed booking was found; false for walk-in
      orderId - the database order ID (-1 if no order exists)
      parkName - the park name for display
      visitorId - the visitor's ID number
      numVisitors - the number of visitors admitted
      orderType - the order type in uppercase (e.g., "INDIVIDUAL", "GROUP")
      totalPrice - the calculated admission price after applicable discounts
      message - a human-readable status or error description
